name: Locus Finance
rootCause: On December 30, 2023, Locus Finance vaults on Ethereum and Arbitrum were compromised due to a leaked developer private key. The attacker used privileged access to upgrade vault contracts and drain $320,964. The team later secured remaining funds and implemented multisig controls. The incident was enabled by a temporary lack of multisig on the development wallet during a CTO transition. A developer's private key was compromised, allowing the attacker to upgrade vaults and withdraw assets.
